$comment: Operating policy for the Website Team. Autonomy is this file, not the agents. See docs/website-team/README.md and the vault's swechha/website/team/04-operating-policy.md.

levels.2: Advisor — diagnose and propose; engineering opens PRs
levels.3: Implementer — implement approved changes without re-asking per file
levels.4: Operator — independently fix, test and deploy the safe_to_automate list
levels.5: Autonomous — continuous loop, escalating high-risk decisions

safe_to_automate: broken internal links and hrefs resolving to no mapped route
restoring whichever of nav-word / built-file / route is missing when the other two agree
missing alt where surrounding text supplies it
a missing skip link in a shared shell
metadata violating an invariant already tested in lib/seo/register.test.ts
regenerating committed pages when generated-current.yml fails
dependency and security updates within a minor version, tests green
anything reversible by a single git revert with no data change
requires_approval: deleting a page or removing a route from a derived map
any new factual claim, figure or citation
database migrations and anything touching Neon
adding or removing a third-party integration
never: add a CSP host without the subresource that needs it, on the same commit
replace a font or image at its existing filename
delete code that has a test
write a sourced figure that has not passed the DOI/URL check
claim to have verified anything against the live site — production returns 403 to this machine
edit app/ believing it is what readers see

allowlist.$comment: Never a recursive search from ~. Enforced by --allowedTools plus the working directory.
